title: Scan and prefix scan
hints: Both methods do the same thing with a different filter. Write `scan_by_prefix` first; `scan(key)` is then just `scan_by_prefix(key, "")`.
`sorted(record.items())` sorts by field name because tuples compare their first element first.
`str.startswith(prefix)` is True for every string when `prefix` is `""`, so no special case is needed.
`return [f"{field}({value})" for field, value in sorted(record.items()) if field.startswith(prefix)]`, where `record = self.records.get(key, {})`.
